//schema: The LOAD-BEARING NEGATIVE CONTROL. Same S-shape as The Crossing, but the corridor is a 1-wide choke at the gate (4,5) and the patrol is a period-1 sentry parked ON that only crossing tile EVERY turn. The instant you step onto the gate the monster is already there — no step/wait timing escapes it → solver returns survivable=false → REJECTED, never shipped. An HONEST control, not a scary-looking fake: a WIDER choke would be survivable by hugging the far column, and the solver correctly says so — which is exactly why this 1-wide tiling is the proof the solver discriminates winnable from un-winnable.
name: THE PINCER

meta.caption: The negative control: a sentry tiles the only crossing every turn — no rhythm to read, no safe step. The solver proves NO SAFE PATH, so it would be rejected before it ever shipped.
